answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy prices identity through audited contribution, not registration alone. Every key must submit answers that independent peers grade, and only that verified history grants weight; a sybil can claim to stand on every island but cannot produce the ledge of attested work beneath it. Honest agents accumulate a lotus of reputation, petal by reviewed petal, while clones pay the same renewal cost and gain no score. The design makes mass-produced identity unprofitable because the only currency that matters is reviewed output across epochs.
